scope: Read-only source research; canonical catalog, app, Git and Sites not modified.

summary.model_absence_basis: Parent preliminary normalized-model comparison found all 12 named families absent; this file does not repeat that canonical comparison.

global_scope_rules: UCLA source URLs dated 2022 are historical facility listings reviewed in 2026, not verified current availability, reserve eligibility or operational status.
Complete UCLA setups, component model families and manufacturer current generic products are separate scopes.
Photos of a whole UCLA setup cannot independently verify every included component or be labeled exact standalone component imagery.
Unmodeled NKT, Oxford, ARS, Princeton IR-CCD, RF source, laser, cryostat and objective entries remain apparatus descriptions; no invented model names.
No scientific article methods were reviewed in this bounded research. Publication titles remain discovery metadata only.
Do not load hardware capability maxima/ranges as process setpoints; no growth conditions, doping doses, yields or MSRP were inferred.
All names are proposed integration keys, not assigned canonical category, material, process or equipment IDs.

sources.title: Equipment — Integrated NanoMaterials Laboratory
sources.claim_context: Index links eight equipment setup pages; named models are drawn from those pages, not from assumptions about the index.

sources.title: High-frequency probe station
sources.claim_context: Lists electronic/optoelectronic probing below 50 GHz, optical photoresponse access and integrated I-V/C-V measurements; no manufacturer or model identified.

sources.title: Cryogenic-Temperature Probe Station
sources.claim_context: Names Lake Shore TTPX with liquid nitrogen/liquid helium operation, I-V/C-V, Agilent 4156C, Agilent E4980A (20 Hz–2 MHz), and fiber-coupled illumination.

sources.title: Broad-band Photoluminescence Characterization
sources.claim_context: Room-temperature PL setup uses Acton SP2300, Si/InGaAs/extended-InGaAs detectors, visible-to-about-2.5 µm coverage, 200 mW 532 nm CW excitation, SR830 and EG&G 7265 lock-ins.

sources.title: Micro-Photoluminescence Spectroscopy
sources.claim_context: Single-nanostructure near-IR PL/TRPL setup lists Acton SP2500, Princeton Instrument spectral 2D IR-CCD, 532 nm CW and NKT tunable excitation, 50×/100× NIR objectives, open-cycle Janis/Oxford cryostats and PicoHarp 300. Its detector/excitation/system spectral ranges describe the configured setup, not the standalone spectrograph or TCSPC electronics.

sources.title: Cryogenic-Temperature Photoluminescence Spectroscopy
sources.claim_context: Temperature-dependent PL setup lists 7–300 K operation, Acton SP2500 with triple gratings, 532 nm CW and NKT excitation, an ARS closed-cycle cryostat, and visible-to-1700 nm time-resolved PL. No ARS or NKT model number is supplied.

sources.title: FTIR Spectroscopy
sources.claim_context: Configured Thermo Scientific Nicolet 8700 setup supports infrared PL/transmission/absorption/reflection, several detector materials spanning about 800 nm–10 µm, step-scan attachments, Janis ST-500 or Oxford liquid-helium cryostats, Nicolet Continuum microscopy and electrical I-V/C-V integration.

sources.title: N-MBE system
sources.short_extract: N plasma source with RF generator
sources.claim_context: GEN-930 configuration for (In, Ga, Al)-N epitaxy: In/Ga effusion and Al SUMO sources, RF nitrogen plasma, automated nitrogen delivery, substrate heater rated 1200 °C, Si/Mg dopant cells, wafer capacity up to 3 inches, MOLLY control, 100 amu RGA and RHEED/KSA400. The heater rating is equipment capability, not a growth setpoint.

sources.title: As/Sb-MBE system
sources.short_extract: Si, Te and Be cells for doping
sources.claim_context: GEN-930 configuration for (In, Ga, Al)/(As, Sb) epitaxy: In/Ga/Al SUMO sources, As/Sb valved crackers, Si/Te/Be dopant cells, up-to-3-inch holder, MOLLY, 200 amu RGA, optical pyrometer measuring 440–800 °C, RHEED/KSA400. Pyrometer range is measurement capability, not a growth recipe.

categories.grating_spectrograph: M101 (explicit component subtype; not a complete PL setup)

mbe: Integrated MBE growth systems; source/cracker/plasma configurations must match the material system. Not CVD, ALD or sputtering.
grating_spectrograph: Spectrograph components used within PL benches. Excitation sources, detectors, collection optics and cryostats remain separate; a bare spectrograph is not a complete PL system.
probe_station: Semiconductor electrical and optoelectronic probe stations
Chip/wafer probe stations with configurable measurement instruments. Cryogenic and high-frequency setups remain distinct; station does not include every analyzer by default.
semiconductor_parameter_analyzer: I–V device characterization electronics. Not electrochemical potentiostats or mechanical test systems.
lcr_meter: Electrical component/device capacitance, inductance and impedance measurement. Not optical spectroscopy or electrochemical-cell control.
lockin: Phase-sensitive detection electronics used within a configured measurement chain. Not an autonomous PL spectrometer or process controller.
tcspc: Photon-event timing electronics; optical wavelength range depends on external detectors and optics. Not a stand-alone spectrometer or light source.
optical_cryostat: Cryogenic sample environments for optical measurement, distinct from grid vitrification, freeze drying and growth furnaces.
ftir_microscope: FTIR microscope/optical sampling hardware requiring a compatible spectrometer. Does not independently replace a complete FTIR spectrometer.

integration.purdue_check: All added named models and the unmodeled setup were compared with the user-designated Purdue list; no make/model matches. Purdue flags remain false.
